desc: Determine the exact feasibility condition using the cycles of permutations \(P\) and \(Q\), including how to handle balls initially in box \(X\).
Derive and justify the ordered operation list for one color by traversing its permutation cycle backward from the predecessor of \(X\).
Prove that combining the red and blue requirements is equivalent to finding a shortest common supersequence, and that the answer is \(|R|+|B|-\mathrm{LCS}(R,B)\).
Design the \(O(N)\) cycle/list construction and the \(O(N\log N)\) LCS-to-LIS computation, with careful handling of empty lists and impossible cases.
Implement stdin parsing and output the minimum operation count or \(-1\) without explicitly simulating ball movements.
